tool_input.command: cd apps/web && ls modules/organization/settings/api-keys -R | head -80; grep -rn "lastUsed" ../../packages/database/schema.prisma | head; grep -n "model ApiKey" -A30 ../../packages/database/schema.prisma
cd apps/web && ls app/api/v3 -R | head -80; ls ../../docs/development/technical-handbook/ ../../docs/api-v3-reference/ ../../.agents/formbricks-context 2>&1 | head -50

cd apps/web/app/api/v3/tags; ls lib; cat lib/schemas.ts lib/operations.ts serializers.ts; cat "../../../../../../docs/api-v3-reference/src/paths/api_v3_tags_{tagId}_merge.yml"; grep -n "tags" ../../../../../../docs/api-v3-reference/src/openapi.yml
cd apps/web/modules/workspaces/settings/tags && ls hooks lib && cat lib/api-client.ts hooks/use-merge-tags.ts lib/errors.ts

cd apps/web/modules/organization/settings/api-keys/lib && sed -i '' 's/PrismaErrorType.RecordDoesNotExist/PrismaErrorType.RecordNotFound/' api-key.ts && sed -i '' 's#^import { ApiKey, ApiKeyPermission, Prisma } from "@formbricks/database/prisma";#&\nimport { PrismaErrorType } from "@formbricks/database/types/error";#; s#^import { DatabaseError, OperationNotAllowedError } from "@formbricks/types/errors";#import { DatabaseError, OperationNotAllowedError, ResourceNotFoundError } from "@formbricks/types/errors";#' api-key.ts && sed -n 1,16p api-key.ts && grep -n "RecordNotFound" api-key.ts
